integrity: The displayed identity is proved analytically by an exhaustive partition into the three possible center labels. Finite enumeration for k=1 through 5 is used only as corroboration of the proof and coefficient arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to ordinary Italian domination on friendship graphs. It does not assert a formula for arbitrary generalized windmills, arbitrary block graphs, or Italian-domination variants. Originality remains exposed to ordinary indexing lag for very recent work.
title: Italian domination polynomial of friendship graphs
